opening_message: Every memory here is real — every date, every moment, every word. This is us. Happy birthday, my Divya.
closing_message: There is so much more I want to write, so much more I want to give you — but some things words can't hold. Just know this: every heartbeat from here belongs to you.

memories.title: Where it all began
memories.message: My brother's earring function — and you came too. We had already spoken before that day, but seeing you there, you looked like a devathai, an angel. I didn't know it yet, but that day quietly became the turning point of my life. From that moment on, my heart beats for you, every single minute — idhayam thudikkum unakaga.

memories.title: The day I came to see you
memories.message: I went to see you, and to meet your family — I don't think I can fully put into words how warm and beautiful they were to me. And you — one moment your eyes were full, the next you were laughing, the way you raised your eyebrows when you smiled — I melted completely. When they finally asked if I liked you, and the answer was yes, my heart was racing like never before. This heart beats only for you — unnakena mattum valum idhayam, uyir ulla varai naan un adimai.

memories.title: Our engagement
memories.message: The day we got engaged. I held your hand for the first time — and I could feel it, right then: you were already my wife, in my heart. All I want is for you to have everything you wish for, for nothing to ever be missing in your life. Wanting that for you — that's not too much to ask, is it? Nee paartha vizhigal, nee paartha nodigal — every glance, every moment you looked at me, I still carry.

memories.title: You came home
memories.message: You came to Tambaram, to my house, for the function. You wore a saree and you looked so beautiful. The place was full of people that day — but for me, there was only one focus in that entire room: you. Per alagi mela oru thurumbum thodathey — not a single speck should ever touch such beauty, and that face should never have to wilt, even for a moment.

memories.title: Festival days, together
memories.message: You were in Tambaram for the festival, there to enjoy it with everyone. I kept telling myself it was all for me — maybe I was just creating my own little happiness out of it. But the truth is simple: all I wanted was to spend that time with you. Un kangalil kanneer sinthinal, ange sethu pogirean — if your eyes ever fill with tears, some part of me stops right there.

memories.title: When you weren't feeling well
memories.message: You weren't feeling well, and I came to see you. We went out on the bike together — I don't know if you noticed, but you held onto my shoulder a little tighter so we'd go faster, and somehow that made me want to go even faster, just for that. That day, it became clear all over again — this was never about how someone looks, it was always about the heart. I may not be the best man in the world, but you — you are a diamond, and I want to give you far more than you deserve. In this life, my eyes, my thoughts, will never fall on anyone else.

final_message: Every version of us, in one frame. Here's to every memory still waiting to happen — happy birthday, Divya.
